position_sizing.conditional_logic: On loss, next lot = previous lot * multiplier; on win, reset to base lot

custom_logic_notes: Martingale progression: after a losing trade, lot size is multiplied by a factor (typically 2x); after a winning trade, lot size resets to base. This creates exponential risk exposure. No hard stop-loss is typical - the TP is set to recover all accumulated losses in the martingale chain plus the original target profit.

Conversion must track trade history to determine next lot size (win/loss state). No indicator dependencies simplifies signal conversion, but the martingale money management state machine requires careful implementation. Margin calculation needed to prevent unrecoverable drawdown.
